findings.title: Outbound client has no request deadline
findings.summary: The payment client can wait indefinitely when its dependency stops responding.
findings.impact: Blocked workers can exhaust the request pool during a dependency outage.

evidence.note: Client options do not define a request timeout.

findings.remediation: Set an explicit timeout and propagate the caller deadline.

findings.title: Latency objective lacks visible SLI wiring
findings.summary: Documentation states a latency objective, but the metric definition needs verification.

evidence.note: Latency objective is documented for the checkout endpoint.
